name: What are the common strategies for managing multiple offers?

mainEntity.name: What are the common strategies for managing multiple offers?

acceptedAnswer.text: When multiple offers come in, an effective strategy involves setting a clear deadline for submission and reviewing all offers simultaneously. This allows you to compare not just price, but also terms like financing, contingencies, and closing dates. Sometimes, a slightly lower cash offer with fewer contingencies can be more appealing than a higher financed offer with many conditions. Our team helps you evaluate the complete package of each offer to identify the strongest terms for your situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Manage multiple offers by setting a submission deadline and comparing all terms, not just price, to find the strongest overall offer.
